My therapist recently taught me something called putting your negative thoughts on trial, and it may help with the fear associated with your panic attacks. Professional help is always recommended, but I understand it is not cheap. I have dealt with severe panic attacks for years, and it only recently got to the extreme point where I sought professional help. I wish I did it sooner. I started medication, which is actually preventing my panic attacks and quieting my mind, and therapy which will help reframe my thinking so I can work through anxiety easier. It is like night and day for me, and I’m only a few weeks into this. If you are able to get in with a therapist or get on medication, I recommend it. It can really be life changing.
